selection_identity_rule: Per task, SHA256(bridge-inner-selection-20261015|shard::record) order; first quarter whole episodes become inner selection. No image/target/error-based choice.
initialization: Fresh43; never initialize from a checkpoint fitted to all64 episodes
model: Original202278 direct x0/DDPM100 recipe with observed-state port; no residual-prior candidate
statistics: Recompute every train-fitted statistic from96 optimization windows only; no inner/outer targets for normalization or any supervised prior
trajectory: One6144-update run,batch8,512 exposures per optimization window; first3072 at1e-4,last3072 at1e-5; no budget extension
selection_rule: Minimize max(inner_episode_equal_position/inner_episode_equal_static_position,inner_episode_equal_rotation/inner_episode_equal_static_rotation),nativeDDPM100 with fixed3 sampling seeds; ties choose earlier step
primary_comparison: Selected checkpoint vs final6144 checkpoint from the SAME96-window training trajectory on original40 outer windows, evaluated only after selection is frozen
fairness: Old128-window runs are background references only; changing actual optimization split prevents attribution against those old runs to selection alone
storage: At most current best and final nonCLIP weights; save all small inner predictions, no optimizer/intermediate weight collection
acceptance: Require selected model to improve both outer mean position and rotation vs same-run final; report comparison to static and all10 episodes. Training error reported, not used to choose checkpoint or force millimetre memorization.
stopping: One fixed selection rule,one trajectory,no automatic extra seeds,regularization changes or new architectures. Negative result closes this specific selection-rule test, not all overfitting explanations.
reason_new_trajectory_needed: Existing128-window series stores only final neural weights and intermediate TRAIN predictions; earlier held-out predictions cannot be recovered from those arrays. Original train.py best.pt selects validation denoising loss, not this independent action-generation selection.
